source: Cameroon GCE Board subject codes (camgceb.org) + MINESEC 2025/2026 school-year calendar (minesec.gov.cm)
notes: subject_codes are the REAL Cameroon GCE Board codes (Ordinary Level 05xx + Advanced-Level-only subjects 07xx), 4-digit zero-padded, from the official board subject lists. Where O-Level and A-Level share a subject name (e.g. Biology 0510 vs 0710), the O-Level code is the default — an A-Level record sets the 07xx code on that subject. Francophone (Baccalauréat) subjects are NOT coded by the GCE Board and keep the mnemonic default. term_windows follow the MINESEC 2025/2026 national calendar (start 8 Sept; breaks 19 Dec-5 Jan and 2-20 Apr; end 31 Jul) and are REPRESENTATIVE — dates shift slightly each year, so each school confirms its own real dates in-app.
